about_the_game:
Experience a story full of romance, choices, and unforgettable moments.

You’ve just started your first semester at university—a world filled with new experiences, unexpected friendships, and situations that will put your decisions to the test. Along the way, you’ll meet different women, each with their own personality, dreams, and secrets.

Every choice you make will shape the story and define your relationships. Will you pursue true love or give in to temptation?

With stunning artwork, an immersive soundtrack, and multiple endings, this visual novel will take you on a unique emotional journey.

Features:
🎭 A branching story where your choices shape the outcome.
💖 Multiple love interests, each with a deep backstory and unique personality.
🎨 High-quality anime-style illustrations with varied expressions and poses.
🎶 An original soundtrack tailored to each scene and character.
🔄 Different endings based on your decisions.

Your story is about to begin. Which path will you choose?
